meta_description: MK Plumbing And Heating Solutions offer expert plumbing and heating services across Nottingham. Fast response, honest pricing. Call today for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Gas Safe Registered — Nottingham's Trusted Heating Experts
hero_subhead: Boiler breakdowns, leaks, or heating faults fixed fast — dependable local tradespeople who turn up on time and get it right.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Nottingham
services_subhead: From emergency call-outs to full boiler installations, we handle every plumbing and heating job with care, skill, and transparent pricing.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: We supply and fit energy-efficient boilers from leading manufacturers, tailored to the size and demands of your home. All installations are Gas Safe certified and come with a full manufacturer's warranty.

services.title: Boiler Servicing & Repairs
services.desc: Annual servicing keeps your boiler running safely and efficiently, reducing the risk of costly breakdowns. Our engineers diagnose and repair faults across all major boiler brands quickly and affordably.

services.title: Central Heating Systems
services.desc: From full system installations to power flushing and radiator upgrades, we ensure your heating runs evenly and efficiently throughout your property. We'll advise on the best solution for your home and budget.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, serious leaks, or no hot water — we respond fast across Nottingham to minimise damage and restore your home. Our engineers carry a wide range of parts to fix most problems in a single visit.

services.title: Bathroom Installations
services.desc: Whether you're fitting a new shower, replacing a suite, or undertaking a full bathroom renovation, we handle all the plumbing work to a high standard. We work cleanly, efficiently, and always leave your home tidy.

services.title: Landlord Gas Safety Certificates
services.desc: We carry out Gas Safe inspections and issue CP12 certificates to keep your rental property legally compliant. Inspections are carried out at a time to suit you and your tenants, with certificates issued promptly.

about_pullquote: Every job we take on, we treat your home with complete respect.
about_para_1: MK Plumbing And Heating Solutions was established to bring honest, reliable plumbing and heating expertise to homeowners across Nottingham and the surrounding areas. Built on word-of-mouth recommendations, we've grown steadily by doing the simple things well — turning up when we say we will, completing work to a high standard, and charging fairly for every job.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us time and again because they know they'll receive straight-talking advice, no unnecessary upselling, and workmanship they can trust. Whether it's a minor repair or a full boiler replacement, we bring the same level of care and professionalism to every call-out.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Called MK Plumbing after waking up to no heating in the middle of winter. They were with me within the hour and had the boiler sorted before lunchtime. Brilliant service, really reasonable price too. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Claire B.

reviews.text: Had a new boiler fitted last month. From the initial quote to the final sign-off, everything was handled professionally and the price was exactly as quoted — no nasty surprises. The engineer was tidy, polite, and clearly knew his stuff.
reviews.author: David H.

reviews.text: Really impressed with the whole experience. I'd had a slow leak under the sink for weeks and other plumbers kept fobbing me off. MK came out the same day, found the issue straight away, and fixed it properly. Won't be going anywhere else.
reviews.author: Priya S.
